lines.zh: 我横着走，沙上留一串印。
lines.en: I walk sideways, leaving prints in the sand.
Eight legs move at once, rustling.
I raise my big claw and shuffle on.
The sand is loose; I sink half an inch.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块晒热的石头。
lines.en: I go around a sun-hot stone.

lines.zh: 潮线那边有味儿，我过去。
lines.en: Something smells past the tide line; I head there.
I drag my shell; I am not fast.

lines.zh: 钳子太重，我身子偏向一边。
lines.en: My claw is heavy; I lean to one side.
I climb over a piece of rotten driftwood.

lines.zh: 沙滩上风大，我压低身子。
lines.en: The beach wind is strong; I keep low.

lines.zh: 我停下来，听听沙里的动静。
lines.en: I stop and listen to the sand.

lines.zh: 我往前探一步，又退半步。
lines.en: I take a step forward, then half back.

lines.zh: 我的脚印很快被浪抹掉。
lines.en: The waves erase my tracks quickly.
Move aside; I am off to dig.
Claws raised, I sidestep out of the way.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着半个椰子，我记住了。
lines.en: Half a coconut is buried here. I will remember.

lines.zh: 我爬过一片湿沙，脚印很深。
lines.en: I cross wet sand, leaving deep prints.

lines.zh: 太阳太晒，我往树影那边挪。
lines.en: Too much sun. I shift toward the tree shade.
I lie on the sand, propped on my claw.
The sun heats my shell.
I groom my antennae with a small claw.

lines.zh: 沙里有东西在动，我听着。
lines.en: Something moves in the sand; I listen.
The waves come slowly, one after another.

lines.zh: 我盯着一只海鸟的影子。
lines.en: I watch a seabird's shadow.
My burrow is cool; I rest at its mouth.
I shake the sand off my legs.

lines.zh: 椰子壳在远处滚了一下。
lines.en: A coconut shell rolls a little way off.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，夜里好办事。
lines.en: I wait for night; nights are better.

lines.zh: 我的钳子比我的脸还大。
lines.en: My claw is bigger than my face.

lines.zh: 有只螃蟹路过，我不理它。
lines.en: A crab passes by; I ignore it.
I blink slowly and close my eyes.
I know this beach well.
You stand on the sand; I raise my claw.

lines.zh: 你的影子凉，我挪过去了。
lines.en: Your shadow is cool; I shuffle into it.
I stare at the coconut by your feet.

lines.zh: 我的左钳比右钳大，你看见了吗。
lines.en: My left claw is bigger than my right; see?

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我钳得紧。
lines.en: Do not reach over; my claw is strong.
You smell of the sea.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，估算你的大小。
lines.en: I tilt my head and size you up.
You are on my burrow; move.
People do not scare me; nets do.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就继续挖。
lines.en: If you stand still, I keep digging.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了一道缝，沙钻进来了。
lines.en: A crack in my shell; sand is getting in.
That blow made my legs weak.
I retreat into my burrow, claw facing out.
One leg no longer obeys me.

lines.zh: 我被掀翻，半天翻不回来。
lines.en: Knocked on my back, I cannot right myself.
Stop hitting; thick shell still hurts.
I back beyond the tide line, panting.
A chip came off my claw.
This wound will take days to heal.

lines.zh: 我的钳尖断了一截，还能夹。
lines.en: A tip of my claw snapped off; I can still pinch.

lines.zh: 椰子的味儿飘过来，我抬头。
lines.en: A coconut scent drifts by; I look up.

lines.zh: 那东西圆圆的，像颗椰子。
lines.en: That round thing looks like a coconut.

lines.zh: 你手里晃的，我盯了半天。
lines.en: I have stared long at what you hold.
Something sweet on the beach; I search.
I shuffle two steps toward your feet.
Turtle eggs tempt me most.
I will not snatch it; I only look.
I dig in the sand. My claws are shovels.
My claw is already open.
A little closer — just one step.
You kick me, and I roll once.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞在石头上，咚一声。
lines.en: My shell hits a stone with a thud.

lines.zh: 别踩，我这把钳子会还手。
lines.en: Do not step there; this claw hits back.
You shoved me into a sand pit.

lines.zh: 我和另一只蟹撞得钳子乱响。
lines.en: Another crab and I clash claws noisily.
That knock flipped me over.
I push back; keep your legs still.
Our scuffle kicks sand everywhere.

lines.zh: 我稳住了，八条腿很有用。
lines.en: I steadied myself; eight legs help.
A bump is nothing; my shell is thick.

lines.zh: 另一只椰子蟹从洞里出来。
lines.en: Another coconut crab comes out of its burrow.

lines.zh: 我们钳子对钳子，碰了一下。
lines.en: We touch claw to claw once.
It is bigger than me; I circle half around.

lines.zh: 我们并排挖沙，谁都不说话。
lines.en: We dig side by side in silence.
It taps its shell; I tap mine.
There will be a few more small holes in the sand.

lines.zh: 我给它让出最凉的那块沙。
lines.en: I yield it the coolest patch of sand.
We only move once the moon is up.
It follows behind me, walking slowly.
Do not come near; we are busy.

lines.zh: 我用大钳夹起一颗椰子。
lines.en: I lift a coconut with my big claw.

lines.zh: 这东西太重，我拖了两步。
lines.en: It is heavy; I drag it two steps.
I carry it toward my burrow.
It dropped; I have to grab it again.
My small claw takes it, steady.
This shell is too smooth to grip.
I lift it to look, then set it down.
Who dropped this? It is mine now.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进洞口，卡住了。
lines.en: I stuff it into the burrow; it sticks.
I use both claws for this.
A sea turtle has climbed onto the beach.
I fix on its slow, flat flippers.

lines.zh: 它往沙里刨坑，正是时候。
lines.en: It digs in the sand — perfect timing.
I drop the coconut and turn toward it.
Its shell is hard, but its legs are soft.
I shuffle toward its hind legs.
It has not seen me; I hug the sand.
The target is by the tide line, close.
This one could feed me for days.
Claw open, I get ready to strike.
I follow it, hiding behind a sand mound.

lines.zh: 它每爬一步，我就近一点。
lines.en: Each step it takes, I get closer.

lines.zh: 我绕到下风口，味道不散。
lines.en: I circle downwind so my scent stays away.
Its flipper slaps the sand; I wait.
I keep low, claw pointed forward.

lines.zh: 海龟在沙里刨坑，我数着它的鳍。
lines.en: The turtle digs in the sand; I count its flipper strokes.
The gap is two body lengths.
The sand is soft; my steps are quiet.
It starts digging, back turned to me.
Wait a little longer; it will tire.
I clamp my claw onto its hind leg.
The claw tightens; it cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 我把它翻过来，露出软腹。
lines.en: I flip it over, baring its soft belly.

lines.zh: 它拍了我一下，我退了半步。
lines.en: It slaps me; I back off half a step.
That pinch took all my strength.
The shell is hard; I go for the neck.
It drags toward the sea; I hold on.
The sand is covered in claw marks.
I cannot bite shell; I pinch soft parts.
After this I need a rest.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，抖掉壳上的沙。
lines.en: I dig out of the sand and shake off the grit.

lines.zh: 潮水刚退，沙滩还是湿的。
lines.en: The tide just went out; the beach is wet.

lines.zh: 我和另一只一起爬出沙坑。
lines.en: Another crab and I climb out of the pit.
The sun is fierce; I look for shade first.
The sand on this beach is fine.

lines.zh: 我的第一颗椰子还没找到。
lines.en: I have not found my first coconut yet.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，试了试力气。
lines.en: I raise my claw and test its strength.
The turtles offshore have not landed yet.

lines.zh: 沙里刚钻出来，钳子还没干。
lines.en: Just out of the sand; my claws are still damp.
Dig a burrow first, then settle in.
My shell crackles in the fire.

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下去，壳磕了。
lines.en: I fall off the rock and crack my shell.

lines.zh: 海水灌进来，我乱了手脚。
lines.en: Seawater floods in; my legs flail.
The blast throws sand; I am half buried.

lines.zh: 有东西射中我的壳，弹开了。
lines.en: Something hit my shell and bounced off.

lines.zh: 这股怪力让我钳子抬不起来。
lines.en: This weird force keeps my claw down.
No coconuts on this beach; I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand; my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有沙，我挖不了洞。
lines.en: No sand here; I cannot dig.
